findings.name: hubness
findings.explanation: k-occurrence skewness 1.17; top 1% of items take 3.9% of all neighbor slots (max N_k=51, expected 10).
likely_causes: high-dimensional concentration (dim >> effective rank)
strong shared direction (see anisotropy)
a few generic items close to the corpus mean
findings.suggested_action: re-rank top-k with mutual k-NN or local scaling; if anisotropy also fails, center first
findings.verify_by: re-run the audit on the transformed vectors and compare hubness.skewness and details.hub_share_top1pct; check that recall on held-out queries did not drop

findings.name: antihubs
findings.explanation: 5.2% of items are never anyone's neighbor (random data at k=10 would give 0.0%); the excess is unreachable through k-NN retrieval.
likely_causes: same causes as hubness
items embedded from empty or near-empty text
findings.suggested_action: inspect a sample of never-retrieved items; drop empty inputs, then apply the hubness fix
findings.verify_by: antihub_excess (antihub_ratio minus the random baseline) should fall below warn_at after the fix; spot-check that the dropped items were genuinely empty

findings.name: anisotropy
findings.explanation: random pairs have mean cosine 0.873 (isotropic ~0); mean unit vector has norm 0.93; centering would bring the cosine to -0.000.
likely_causes: model emits a large shared component (common in older text embedding models)
un-normalized vectors with a constant offset
findings.suggested_action: subtract the corpus mean vector and re-normalize, applying the same transform to queries; details.mean_random_cosine_after_centering shows the expected result
findings.verify_by: re-audit the centered vectors; then compare retrieval quality on real queries before and after, because centering changes the ranking

findings.name: effective_rank
findings.explanation: effective rank 69.2 of 128 attainable (128 dims; 54.1%); low values mean most dimensions carry nothing.
likely_causes: model dimensions mostly unused
corpus covers a very narrow topic
a rogue dimension dominates the variance
findings.suggested_action: if rogue_dimensions also fails, standardize dimensions; otherwise consider PCA or Matryoshka truncation to the effective rank to cut index size
findings.verify_by: re-audit after the transform; recall@k of the truncated index against the full exact k-NN should stay above 0.95

findings.name: collapse
findings.explanation: 0.0% of items have a neighbor with cosine >= 0.99 or an exact copy (exact duplicates 0.0%); no row has a near-duplicate.
likely_causes: duplicate or boilerplate documents
chunking that repeats headers/footers
embedding failures returning a constant vector
findings.suggested_action: read details.largest_near_duplicate_groups: a few huge groups point at an embedding failure or boilerplate (re-embed or fix chunking), many small groups at duplicate items (deduplicate or collapse them at serving time); details.sample_pairs lists row pairs to inspect
findings.verify_by: near_duplicate_ratio should drop below warn_at; top-k on sample queries should no longer repeat the same item

findings.name: rogue_dimensions
findings.explanation: dimension 94 alone holds 1.0% of variance, 1.3x the uniform share of 0.78%; top 3 dims hold 3.0%. Rogue dimensions dominate cosine.
likely_causes: model outputs a few high-variance coordinates (known in BERT-family encoders)
findings.suggested_action: z-score each dimension or drop details.rogue_dims before indexing; apply the same transform to queries
findings.verify_by: top1_dim_variance_ratio falls below warn_at; retrieval quality on real queries does not regress

findings.name: norms
findings.explanation: vector norms vary with CV 0.000 (median 1.000, range 1.000-1.000); 0.00% are zero vectors. Unequal norms bias inner-product search toward long vectors.
likely_causes: vectors not L2-normalized
zero vectors from empty inputs or failed embedding calls
findings.suggested_action: drop zero vectors; L2-normalize before indexing if cosine ranking is intended
findings.verify_by: norm_cv near 0 and zero_norm_ratio 0 on re-audit; metric_mismatch returns to 1.0

findings.name: metric_mismatch
findings.explanation: cosine and inner-product top-10 share 100.0% of neighbors; 100.0% of items get identical lists. Low overlap means the index metric changes the results.

details.skipped: norms are uniform, cosine == inner product

likely_causes: vector norms vary, so cosine and inner-product rankings diverge
findings.suggested_action: decide which metric the index uses; normalize vectors if cosine is intended, or keep norms deliberately if length should carry relevance
findings.verify_by: topk_overlap above warn_at, or a documented decision to keep inner product

findings.name: distance_concentration
findings.explanation: on 3000 rows a random item is 3.27x farther than the nearest neighbor (random distance 0.127); isotropic noise at 128-d and the same rows would give 1.44x, so the contrast is 2.28x that of noise. On all rows the contrast is 3.27x (median NN distance 0.039). Near 1.0 means distances carry no signal.
likely_causes: curse of dimensionality on near-isotropic vectors
model with little structure for this domain
findings.suggested_action: try a different model or dimensionality reduction; add a re-ranker over a larger candidate set
findings.verify_by: contrast_over_noise rises above warn_at; expect ann_recall to improve as well

findings.name: outliers
findings.explanation: 0.30% of items have no neighbor within cosine distance 0.050 (median 0.039); see details.sample_ids. Typically junk, empty or foreign-language content.
likely_causes: junk, empty or foreign-language documents
chunks of code or tables embedded as prose
a few vectors from a different model
findings.suggested_action: inspect details.sample_ids; remove or re-embed them
findings.verify_by: outlier_ratio below warn_at; the removed items were confirmed irrelevant

findings.name: connectivity
findings.explanation: 0.00% of items sit in 0 small island(s) of the k-NN graph (fewer than 15 items; 60 components in total). Graph-based ANN (HNSW) attaches islands to the wrong region or never reaches them.
likely_causes: tiny self-contained groups (near-duplicates, boilerplate) isolated from the rest
corpus assembled from disconnected sources
findings.suggested_action: inspect details.sample_ids; deduplicate or merge; for HNSW raise M / ef_construction
findings.verify_by: island_ratio below warn_at; ANN recall measured on items from former islands is comparable to the rest
